"Money" is the main currency of the Donut Smp. Money can be earned by selling items, either through the built in sell feature, the Auction House, and through orders. Money can be used to buy things from either of the methods listed before, or can be used to buy things from the built in shop. 

== Auction House ==
The Auction House is one of the three methods of obtaining/selling items. Players can either buy items from the auction market, or they can sell items for other players to buy. The Auction House's main purpose is to acquire specific items from other players (although you can buy items in bulk via shulker boxes). The auction house can be accessed by typing (/ah) or (/auction) or /shop  into the chat bar. 

== Orders ==
Orders are the main way of obtaining items in bulk. Players can list orders for a certain amount of items, and a certain price per item. At anytime during the order's course, you can pick up the items that players have delivered to you. The order menu is not recommended as a way to buy specific items, but as a way to buy items in bulk quantities. Orders are open for about 24 hours and after the order is concluded, a player will have 90 hours to claim the items. The order menu can be accessed by typing (/order) or (/orders) into the chat bar.

== Selling/Economy ￼ ==
Any item (except for spawners) can be sold in the auction house (/ah), delivered on orders (/orders) or sold to the server using the "/sell" command [NOT RECOMMENDED]. Each item has a default sell price that usually stays permanent (except in the case of events like carved pumpkin halloween or a personal [[Sell Multiplier|sell multliplier.]]

Money usually inflates a lot, and holds no actual investment value. For this reason, many people choose to buy [[investment items]] like enchanted golden apples, gilded blackstone, elytras, dragon heads, diamond horse armour and spawners (only via third party trading, leading to possible scams) to preserve their money value. However, a [[Border Expansion|border expansion]] may cause everything to drop in value.
